overview.commentary: The portfolio returned 76.41% annualised against 24.07% volatility (Sharpe 2.29) — excellent risk-adjusted performance at a moderate risk level. BAC carries the largest weight at 35.0%; AMD dominates risk contribution at 37.2%. On a typical bad day expect losses near 2.36% (95% VaR), with the worst 5% averaging 3.05% (CVaR) and peak-to-trough drawdown over the period of -12.81%. Action: trim or hedge AMD — it is the single biggest driver of portfolio risk.

risk.commentary: Monte Carlo (10k paths, 1Y horizon): 95% VaR -0.10%, 99% VaR 15.71%, CVaR 95% 9.67%. Probability of >20% loss: 0.58%. Worst historical replay is GFC_peak_to_trough (-73.17% return, max drawdown -75.89%, worst day -20.29%). GARCH(1,1) 30-day forecast vol is 27.17% vs realised 26.11% — vol regime rising.
